senses.gloss: (cmp. b. h. גְּבָל) [Highland,] Gabla, Gabalena, a district (and town) South or South West of Jerusalem, occupied by Edomites (v. Graetz Monatsschrift 1875, p. 61 sq.; 1880, p. 481 sq.).
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 36:20">Targ. Y. Gen. XXXVI, 20</cite>; <cite ref="I Chronicles 1:38">I Chr. I, 38</cite> (h. text <cite ref="U01660"><he>שֵׂעִיר</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 33:2">Targ. Y. I Deut. XXXIII, 2</cite>.—
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 59a">Ab. Zar. 59ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Ketubot 112a:4">Keth. 112ᵃ</cite> <he>איקלע לג׳</he> came to Gabla. Cmp. <cite ref="C00113"><he>גַּבְלָן</he></cite>.
